description: Na₄Hf₂(SiO₄)₃ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.94 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.65 Å. Hf is bonded to six O atoms to form HfO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.04 Å) and three longer (2.12 Å) Hf-O bond lengths. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent HfO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 29-34°. All Si-O bond lengths are 1.64 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Hf, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing ONa₃HfSi trigonal bipyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na, one Hf, and one Si atom.
